description:
My name's Gene Halvorsen. I live in North Pole, Alaska, fifteen miles outside Fairbanks, where it hits forty below most winters. I hauled heating oil on the same route for thirty-seven winters and looked after houses for people who left when the cold came. I've been inside a thousand cold houses, and most of them weren't cold. They were windy.

This channel is the cheap fix first. Door sweeps, gaskets, rope caulk, a flashlight walk after dark. Fifteen dollars before five thousand. Every method has a price on it and a house where it mattered.

The book is A Thousand Cold Houses, twenty-five methods, one per chapter, at genehalvorsen.com. New video every couple of days.

Keep the heat where you paid for it.
